cosmology.provenance: Numerical inputs declared in the Korean twist-stress report; H0 and the effective dark-component fraction trace to the cited Planck 2018 analysis. C=1 is the WRRA matched-response closure assumption.

galaxy_comparison.provenance: External low-acceleration comparison benchmark. It is not used in the forward calculation of a_T.

dbi_imported_scaffold.provenance: Imported relativistic Khronon/DBI scaffold following Blanchet and Skordis (2024), with the parameter values declared in the twist-stress report.
